definitions.meaning: Thick wine, wine with a froth on it (?)

quotations.latin: quantum distal dulcisapa a merulento temeto, Ald. 81, 1

quotations.old_english: Merum hlúttor wín, dulcisapa áwilled wín

source_text: reám-wín, es; n. Thick wine, wine with a froth on it (?) :-- Reámwín dulcisapa (quantum distal dulcisapa a merulento temeto, Ald. 81, 1), An. Ox. 8, 417: 8 b, 12. Cf. Merum hlúttor wín, dulcisapa áwilled wín, Wrt. Voc. i. 290, 55-56.
